name: security-audit
description: Security auditor skill for codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons. Runs a six-phase workflow with isolated agents: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, adversarial candidate validation, structured findings, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. Guidance mode by default, full audit mode only on an explicit audit or pen-test request. Verbatim vendor of cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT). Use when the user asks for a security audit, vulnerability review, pen test of source code, or security guidance.
